description.narrative: In the framework of HPMP stage I the Government of the Republic of North Macedonia decided to accelerate the HCFC phase-out process and to make the measures and restrictions stricter. The reduction schedule foresees a 50% reduction of the average HCFC consumption in the period 2009-2010 (baseline 1.8 ODP tonnes) and the final elimination in 2028 (12 years ahead the official Montreal Protocol elimination date).The first HPMP stage covered a 40% reduction and the second stage (2021 # 2027) will complete the HCFC phase-out in the country.
